messages.content: I would like to upload some files and PDFs to work with, what's the path to my files or how can I upload

You have a few easy ways to upload and work with files or PDFs: ### 1. Upload Directly via Chat (Best for analysis or review) * **How:** Click the **paperclip / attachment icon** in the chat input or drag and drop files directly into this chat box. * **Best when:** You want me to read, summarize, extract text from, or incorporate content from your documents into the site. --- ### 2. Drag & Drop into the File Explorer (Best for website downloads/viewing) * **How:** In the file tree / explorer on the left sidebar, drag and drop files directly into the project folder. * **Workspace Path:** The root path is: `/home/agent/workspace/` * **Best when:** You want PDFs or documents hosted on your website so visitors can view or download them. > [!TIP] > If you upload PDFs for site visitors, we can organize them into a `files/` or `documents/` folder (alongside [images](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/images/)), and link them directly in [index.html](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/index.html) or [forms.html](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/forms.html) like: > ```html > Download Brochure (PDF) > ``` --- ### 3. Via GitHub * You can also upload or commit files directly to your GitHub repository (**`taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website`**). --- Once you upload or attach them, let me know what you'd like to do with them (e.g., add download buttons on the site, display their contents, etc.)!

All three updates have been implemented and saved:

---

### 1. Form Tab Selected State (Font Stays Crisp White)
* **What was happening**: In [`forms.html`](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/forms.html#L59), when a form button was selected, the dark green background (`#06261b`) was applied, but the inner text was styled with dark gray classes (`text-slate-800`), making it almost invisible against the green.
* **What changed**: 
  - The active tab title is now locked to **pure white (`#ffffff !important`)**.
  - The subtitle is now a **bright, high-contrast light mint-white (`#e2e8f0 !important`)**, ensuring perfect readability on both mobile and desktop.

---

### 2. What "Founder Business Acceleration" Means
In business consulting and advisory firms, **Founder Business Acceleration** refers to:
> **1-on-1 strategic scaling and executive advisory for business owners & founders.**  
> It is designed for founders who are trapped working *in* the day-to-day firefighting of the business, helping them transition into working *on* the business as a strategic leader. It focuses on founder-level decision making, unit economics, executive delegation, capital/pitch readiness, and high-velocity commercial scaling.

* **Improvement made**: To prevent confusion for clients browsing your services, the option label in the dropdown on both [`forms.html`](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/forms.html#L544) and [`index.html`](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/index.html#L2008) has been clarified to:
  **`Founder Business Acceleration (1-on-1 Founder & Business Scaling)`**
*(If you prefer an alternative title like "Founder Advisory & Strategic Coaching" or "SME Scale-Up Sprint", let me know and I can adjust it anytime!)*

---

### 3. Industry Dropdown on All Business Forms
Both the **Business Audit** and **Consulting Inquiry** forms (on both [`forms.html`](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/forms.html) and [`index.html`](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/index.html)) now feature a standardized dropdown containing comprehensive industry categories to streamline your analysis and Google Sheets reporting:

1. **Agriculture & Agribusiness**
2. **Banking, Financial Services & FinTech**
3. **Construction, Real Estate & Infrastructure**
4. **Consumer Goods & FMCG**
5. **Creative Arts, Media & Entertainment**
6. **Education, Training & EdTech**
7. **Energy, Oil & Gas, Renewables & Utilities**
8. **Healthcare, Pharmaceuticals & Medical**
9. **Hospitality, Tourism, Food & Restaurants**
10. **Legal, Accounting & Professional Services**
11. **Logistics, Supply Chain, Freight & Transport**
12. **Manufacturing & Industrial Production**
13. **Marketing, Advertising & Public Relations**
14. **Non-Profit, NGO & Social Development**
15. **Retail, Wholesale, Import & Export**
16. **Technology, Software & Telecommunications**
17. **Other / Multi-Sector Enterprise**

---

All changes are saved. You can test the tab selector and new industry dropdowns directly here:

### Summary of Changes:

1. **Free Business Audit Form (`forms.html`)**:
   - **Removed Free vs. Paid Consulting Option**: Removed the track switcher banner and dropdown (*"Are you looking for a one-time free audit or a paid in-depth strategy & review?"*). The form is now solely dedicated to **Get a Free Business Audit**.
   - **Removed Response Format Selector**: Removed the *"Preferred Response Format"* dropdown field.
   - **Updated Copy & Badges**: Updated tab headers, diagnostic card, badges (*"Free Business Audit • Delivered via WhatsApp in 24h"*), and the primary action button to **"Submit & Get My Free Business Audit"**.

2. **Homepage Updates (`index.html`)**:
   - **Call-to-Action Updates**: Replaced all instances of *"Custom Video Audit"* with **"Get Your Free Business Audit"** across the hero CTA, bottom CTA banner, and navigation action buttons.
   - **Interactive Modal**: Updated the modal title to **"Get A Free Business Audit"**, removed the free/paid option and response format selector, and set the submission button to **"Submit & Get My Free Business Audit"**.

3. **Sidebar Header Brand Logo (`index.html`, `forms.html`, `events.html`, `careers.html`)**:
   - Replaced the plain text `"Navigation"` in all mobile/drawer sidebars with the official **The Affluentaccelerators logo** (brand geometric emblem + *"the Affluentaccelerators"* typography + *"BUSINESS | WEALTH | IMPACT"* subtitle).

4. **Form Submit Button & Loading State**:
   - Removed all technical backend process text (*"Uploading to Google Drive & Transmitting..."*, *"Transmitting to Advisory Council..."*, *"Transmitting to Central Database..."*, etc.).
   - Replaced button loading states across all forms with a clean, smooth loading spinner animation and discreet **"Please wait..."** text.
   - Updated file uploader preview indicators to show **"Secure upload"** and **"Ready to submit"**.
